description: Get a paginated list of the channel's uploaded videos with engagement metrics (views, likes, comments, duration). Returns up to 50 per page.

account.description: Account name to query. Use list_accounts to see available options. Defaults to the first configured account.

max_results.description: Number of videos to return (1-50, default 25)

page_token.description: Pagination token from a previous response's next_page_token.

name: get_videos
